x: The Belgrave contingent was led by Carl Lawton most of the way and he arrived in Calne 38th in 51.40 to be followed by Veronique Lauer who was 5th in the ladies race one second behind Carl.

In the Senior races Andrew Goudie placed 4th, Mick Graham 5th and Paul Warburton, on one his occasional trips out managed 8th. Our only winner of the day was Veronique Lauer in the senior women's event. Nice to see our ladies back on the winning trail.
